jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer Manager (f/m/d) – Projektmanagement (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
University Medical Center Goettingen (UMG) is committed to systematically strengthening the transfer of scientific findings into medical applications and accelerating the advancement of research for the benefit of patients. The UMG Technology Transfer & Accelerator Office offers an interesting, challenging, and collaborative work environment dedicated to promoting the “transfer” of research findings into medical applications and improving the diagnosis, treatment, and/or prevention of diseases. The UMG Accelerator, as a core element, is a highly professional, multidisciplinary unit that brings together scientific projects with translational potential and therefore collaborates with internal management as well as a wide range of external international consultants and CROs.
This position is funded by the “UMG2032 – Excellence through Focus” project, supported by zukunft.niedersachsen, the joint science funding program of the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture and the Volkswagen Foundation.

Your tasks

- Familiarize yourself with the research projects at UMG by engaging with researchers and students and systematically analyzing scientific papers and grant proposals for their potential for commercial exploitation
- Evaluate the commercial potential of research projects based on basic and clinical translational research, research findings, and the molecular and clinical validation of a target molecule in comparison to other clinical programs and indications
- Collaboration with contract research organizations (CROs) and external consultants as part of project partnerships
Y- ou possess market knowledge in the life sciences fields relevant to UMG, ranging from medical devices to pharmaceutical products
- Management of databases for translational projects, as well as project and process management and the creation of SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)
- Maintaining working relationships with companies and investors, attending conferences, and reading professional literature

Your qualifications

- Doctorate in natural sciences, biotechnology, or medicine (PhD)
- A MBA or other master’s degree is a plus but not required
- Expertise in the development of a life sciences product or marketing experience with life sciences products at a pharmaceutical company
- Excellent presentation skills and proficiency with standard MS Office programs
- Ability to work in a team, strong execution skills, and good communication skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German
- Experience in drug development and knowledge of regulatory affairs

We offer

- A challenging and varied role within a dedicated and motivated team
- A structured and supportive onboarding process
- Opportunities to develop individual strengths and skills through our comprehensive training and development program
- Support for health and fitness through an excellent workplace health management program and a wide range of attractive benefits (including state-of-the-art facilities, employee discounts at gyms, commuter passes, on-site childcare, and after-school care)
- Compensation in accordance with the state’s collective bargaining agreement for public employees (up to TV-L EG13, subject to meeting the personal requirements), including public-sector benefits such as a supplemental pension (VBL)

jobs.occupation: Logistics Cost Analyst (d/f/m) (Controller/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

We are currently looking for a Logistics Cost Analyst (d/f/m) to join our team in Hamburg-Fuhlsbüttel.

We are a diverse, highly collaborative team of supply chain and logistics experts driving operational excellence and cost efficiency across European central and regional distribution centers in the aerospace spare parts aftermarket. As our regional organisation evolves, you will work closely alongside team leads and operational specialists across international sites to steer financial performance and support strategic decision-making.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees. Local benefits may vary:

- Competitive Remuneration
- Work / Life Balance: Hybrid Working, flex-time, maternity/ paternity leave, job sharing
- Personal Development: Personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions & lots of internal mobility opportunities
- Health & Wellbeing: Health insurance, well-being programs

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM

- You will deploy a high-precision financial monitoring system across all European locations to deliver complete spend transparency.
- You will lead the annual operational planning process, monitor actuals against plans, run root-cause analyses for deviations, and manage global financial risks and opportunities.
- You will oversee purchase order execution for business services, consumables, facility operations, and equipment while ensuring budget compliance.
- You will benchmark and analyze supplier contracts for outsourced warehouse operations, initiate cost reduction initiatives, and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders, goods receipts, and invoices.
- You will contribute to the global logistics transformation roadmap by building project business cases, unit cost models, and make-or-buy analyses.
- You will design and roll out financial key performance indicators (KPIs) that empower operational teams to boost cost efficiency.
- You will develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships across different departments, sites, and service providers in an international environment.

ABOUT YOU

Equipped with a degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related discipline, paired with professional experience in logistics cost controlling or contract logistics, we are looking for a team player with the following experience, skills and mindset:

- You hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field.
- You bring solid professional experience in supply chain financial steering and contract logistics.
- You demonstrate a strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data analytics tools.
- You show proven ability to build collaborative business relationships and communicate effectively across international teams.
- You feature a structured, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset combined with strong organizational capabilities.
- You possess business fluency in both German and English.

Satair is striving for a culture of diversity and inclusiveness with continuous learning, speak up, listen up, and act with integrity and respect. So we welcome any application independent from the social and cultural background, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion of the applicant.

About SATAIR

Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our websitewww.SATAIR.com (https://www.satair.com/) or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel atwww.youtube.com/sataircompany (https://www.youtube.com/sataircompany) !

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Business Development Specialist - Biomonitoring (all genders) - East, North-West, Rhine-Main (Pharmazeut/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

Microbiological contamination control is at the heart of pharmaceutical manufacturing quality — and in this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding a cutting-edge portfolio of microbiological testing and automation solutions across key German markets. You will take full ownership of a defined territory, developing and executing a strategic account plan that targets new customer acquisition, deepens existing relationships, and positions the portfolio as the partner of choice within the pharmaceutical and biotech sector.

You will engage consultatively with technical and commercial stakeholders across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, guiding them through high-value capital investment decisions with clarity and credibility. By combining deep microbiological expertise with a structured approach to pipeline management, you will identify untapped market opportunities, introduce advanced automation and robotics solutions, and deliver measurable revenue growth. Your ability to navigate long sales cycles and translate technical value into business outcomes will be central to your success in this role.

Who you are:

- You bring at least 5 years of field sales experience in pharmaceutical quality control, production, or a closely related life science sector, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding commercial targets in complex business-to-business environments.
- You hold academic degree in microbiology, biology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience); knowledge of laboratory automation or robotics is a strong advantage.
- You have in-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical quality control and production environments, including familiarity with Good Manufacturing Practice guidelines, Annex 1 and cleanroom or aseptic processing requirements.
- You are experienced in managing high-value, long-cycle capital expenditure sales processes, including stakeholder mapping across complex organizational structures and engagement at management level.
- You are fluent in German (C2) and English (C1); an established professional network within the German pharmaceutical or life sciences industry is highly advantageous.
- You hold a valid driver’s license and are willing to spend the majority of your working time in the field across east & north-west Germany as well as in the rhine-main area; candidates based within these regions are preferred.
- You demonstrate strong negotiation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage credibly across both technical and commercial functions.
- You have a proven ability to manage territory, spending over 70% of time in the field, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and you are highly self-directed and results-oriented, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and territory planning.
- You are familiar with artificial intelligence concepts and tools, including their practical applications and limitations, and are able to apply this understanding to evaluate and use AI-supported solutions responsibly in a commercial context.

Location

Germany (East / North-West / Rhine-Main ) | Field-based with regional travel

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Chartering Broker (f/m/d) – Regional Trade & Project Cargo (Intra-Europe) (Schifffahrtskaufmann/-frau - Trampfahrt)
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

Briese Chartering is an established Shipowner/Carrier based in Leer/Germany managing a modern and versatile fleet of short-sea and multipurpose (MPP) vessels ranging from 3,000 to 10,000 DWT with a strong focus on carriage of project cargo. For further information see: www.briese-chartering.com (http://www.briese-chartering.com/)   

We are seeking an experienced Chartering Broker to join our Intra-Europe Regional Trade desk. In this role you will hold commercial responsibility for maximizing the utilization and profitability of our owned and controlled tonnage. You will optimize vessel loops across Europe, securing high-yielding regional breakbulk and specialized project cargo stems by maintaining direct relationships with industrial charterers, shippers and project forwarders.

Negotiate charter parties directly with cargo owners and competitive brokers, protecting the company's commercial interests. 

Fleet Optimization & Chartering 

Fix our 3,000–10,000 DWT fleet on Voyage Charters and Contracts of Affreightment (COAs) across European trade routes (Baltic, North Sea, Continent, Mediterranean/Black Sea and North/West Africa). 

Optimize vessel routing and scheduling to minimize ballast days and maximize daily time charter equivalent returns.

Project Cargo & Voyage Estimation 

Evaluate and price specialized project cargo inquiries tailored to our vessels' capabilities. 

Perform precise voyage calculations including bunker tracking, port/terminal expenses, and laytime analysis to ensure optimal margins. 

Market Integration & Collaboration 

Leverage the north/central European shipping community while managing an active network of international chartering contacts. 

Work closely with our in-house operations and technical management teams in Leer to guarantee smooth post-fixture execution. 

Qualifications & Experience 

 Essential Criteria 

- Minimum 3 years of commercial experience on the owner’s side or with an exclusive broker specifically within the European short-sea or small-MPP sectors. 
- Solid understanding of 3k–10k DWT vessel capabilities including stowage configurations, deck strength and regional port/canal restrictions. 
- Deep knowledge of European trades including seasonal weather factors, ice clauses and short-sea port operations. 
- Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German is highly preferred given our regional hub and team integration. 

Core Skills 

- Commercial drive with a clear focus on asset P&L and strategic fleet positioning. 
- Proficiency in voyage estimation and other standard software tools (MS Office, Sedna, Netpas, etc.). 
- Existing network of direct project cargo clients, industrial shippers and European forwarders.

Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Verhandlungsführung, Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnung, Schifffahrtsrecht
Expertenkenntnisse: Befrachtung

jobs.occupation: Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

The role goes beyond merely operating existing quantum software stacks. It also involves designing modular,hardware-agnostic backends capable of seamlessly integrating both simulators and current NISQ devices. Thisrequires:

Running simulations on HPC systems, including efficiently parallelizing computational tasks

Writing HPC-executable, production-ready code

Ensuring scalability and robustness of algorithms in large-scale environments

Identifying and resolving error sources in the integrated hybrid stack, particularly cascading errors acrossmodules

Developing independent code for simulations, extending beyond the use of standard software libraries

Requirements

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Good knowledge of diverse quantum hardware, error correction/mitigation strategies, and respective SDKecosystems (Qiskit, Cirq, Braket, Qrisp, AutoQML, etc.)

Advanced linear algebra knowledge: matrix diagonalization methods, magnus expansion, Zassenhausformula, group theory

Advanced quantum physics knowledge: quantum circuit design, Trotterization, quantum machine learning, etc

Demonstrated experience running simulations on HPC systems

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)

Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques

Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector ortensor-network simulators)

Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms

Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Knowledge in writing bash scripts for HPC job submission

German B2 or higher

Our offer

Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form:

https://bewerbermanagement.net/67hhg

The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. TheGWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expresslyencouraged.

If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail:

jancillie.louw@gwdg.de ).

The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Focus:

Connecting quantum workloads to GWDG’s existing HPC infrastructure. Requires a deep understanding ofboth classical HPC architectures and the specific characteristics of quantum jobs. The developer will takeresponsibility for scheduler logic, including:

SLURM partition mapping

Optimization of SLURM execution for Quantum Computing Jobs

Implement HPC transpilation pipelines and, more generally, workflows for HPC/AI pre- and post-processing

Performance tuning of hybrid workloads

Implementation of monitoring and benchmarking mechanisms

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Ability to code in Python

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Demonstrable expertise in optimizing HPC stacks for proper system implementation and tuning

Experience building and operating software-based services, ensuring long-term maintainability

Knowledge in QC (quantum computing) job characteristics and resource requirements, and familiarity withcompiler/transpiler pipelines

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit

all

Desirable

Experience benchmarking and profiling hybrid classical/quantum or GPU workloads

Experience enabling optimal, resource-efficient operation of hybrid classical/quantum workloads

German B2 or higher

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

jobs.occupation: Embedded & Systems Software Developer for PETRA IV (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Embedded & Systems Software Developer for PETRA IV

Limited: 2 years | Start: 01.01.2027 | ID: FSMA045/2026 | Deadline: 08.11.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Photon-Science Detector Group designs and builds innovative and state-of-the-art X-ray cameras for us in a variety of scientific experiments, in Hamburg and world wide. We are developing new high-speed cameras for an upcoming major upgrade to our X-ray facilities, PETRA IV, and improved software is required for camera control, data handling, and interfacing to users and the facility's systems. We are looking for a software developer to work on these tasks together with our experts in detector engineering and scientific computing.

With the PETRA IV project, DESY is launching one of the most ambitious and innovative large-scale research projects worldwide. PETRA IV, the most brilliant synchrotron radiation source of the next generation, will be the ultimate 4D X-ray microscope, setting new standards in precision and performance. To implement the project, we are looking for motivated employees who want to get involved in a complex project with international appeal. More information about PETRA IV: PETRA IV (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/696)

About your role:

- Developing software for controlling and configuring a large camera system consisting of multiple units
- Developing a system for receiving detector data at high speed on a set of data acquisition PCs, in collaboration with experts in hardware acceleration
- Developing the interfaces between the X‑ray camera and the facility's control and scientific computing systems

About you:

- Master's degree in software engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Experience with embedded and/or systems programming
- Experience with both Python and a lower-level language (preferably C++)
- Good standard of English
- Good team player, and the ability to work effectively with experts in other fields (firmware developers and detector engineers)
- Experience with high performance computing
- Experience with high-speed networking

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work‑life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations

For further information, please contact David Pennicard at +49 40 8998‑4544 (https://tel:+494089984544) (david.pennicard@desy.de (david.pennicard@desy.de) ).

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).

We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:

Apply now! (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043)

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/2820) is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/699) ).

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.

To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.

As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.

Your Responsibilities:

- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope
- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project
- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one
- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time
- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover
- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components
- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it
- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of them

What You Bring:

- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment
- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials
- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)
- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes
- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity
- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement
- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time
- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process
- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at both

How We Work:

- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule
- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities
- You don't need to be based in Germany
- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement
- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate it

What We Offer:

- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover
- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec
- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes
- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package
- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits
- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment

﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. Instead, send us a brief project portfolio describing a project you have taken from the initial phase through execution and final handover, highlighting your responsibilities, key challenges, and achieved results.

**Take Your Opportunity - **Join us and actively contribute to the continued growth and development of our company. Together, we strive to inspire our employees and customers through innovative technology, modern structures, and sustainable growth

Together Towards the Future. Are You Ready to Join Us?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Ms. Jasmin Hohmann at +49 561 50019-201.

Convince Us. We Look Forward to Getting to Know You!

Constructor University is seeking to fill a tenure-track faculty position in organic chemistry with a focus on synthetic organic chemistry, and we invite applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by January 2027:

Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d)
(full-time, tenure-track, initially limited to 3 years)

The School of Science is particularly interested in a candidate who combines experimental and computational or theoretical approaches for the development of synthetic methodology and synthesis of bioactive molecules or functional materials. jobs.occupation: Ph.D. Researcher (m/f/d) Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and transdisciplinary cooperation. According to the 2024 Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings, Constructor University is among the top 25 percent out of more than 1900 universities worldwide and is ranked as the second most international university in the world. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1,600 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.

The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).

This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.

Key objectives include:

- Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.
- Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.
- Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.
- Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.

The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.

Your Profile:

- Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.
- Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.
- Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.
- Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.
- A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.
- Documented experience in practical research work.
- Strong skills in academic English writing (peer-reviewed papers, reports, or equivalent).

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

- Monthly stipend of €1,650
- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Application Details

- Expected start date: February, 2026

Application package must include: 

- Curriculum Vitae (CV)
- Academic transcripts 
- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals
- 2 recommendation letters

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.
